label: Wizz Air 3257, an Airbus A321 (HA-LXF, callsign WMT7403), lines up on runway 08L at Bucharest Henri Coandă for Tel Aviv. It is due at Ben Gurion at 08:25 Israel time.
Level at 35,000 ft over eastern Bulgaria. The route runs south past Istanbul, across western Turkey and out over the Mediterranean at Antalya.
04:29: over Antalya and out over the sea, on a straight line for Tel Aviv, less than an hour from landing.

West of Cyprus the aircraft's broadcasts flag its GPS position as unreliable, and after 04:43:27 they carry no position at all: the satellite-navigation interference that flights meet in the eastern Mediterranean. Altitude, speed and direction are still heard.
From here the path is worked out from the speeds and directions the aircraft kept sending, flown on from its last position. The squawk is 5541, with no emergency declared, now or later.
04:52: heard for two minutes. Still level at 35,000 ft on 142°, straight for Tel Aviv, with 35,000 ft selected.
Last heard on course for Tel Aviv
For the next ten minutes nobody hears it. In that time it starts down and turns back.
About 75 nm south of Larnaca and 140 nm short of Tel Aviv, it turns left, away from Israel. The moment is an estimate: the turn itself was not heard.
05:03:39: heard again, heading north-east at 432 kt, descending through 22,700 ft at 1,800 ft/min with 12,000 ft selected. It is going to Larnaca.
Why it diverted has not been published. Ben Gurion stayed open: the flights due there around the same time landed normally.
05:10: heading 015° at 13,100 ft and 250 kt indicated. The selected altitude goes to 7,000 ft, then 4,000 ft.
Last heard before the approach: 9,950 ft
After 05:12:06 it is not heard for almost ten minutes. The approach drawn here, a left turn over Larnaca Bay onto runway 22, is the simplest one that fits the time.
GPS position returns on short final
05:21:49: its GPS position is back, 500 m short of the runway threshold at 147 kt.
It lands on runway 22 at Larnaca at 05:22 UTC, 08:22 in Cyprus: about when it was due in Tel Aviv. Ben Gurion's board lists the flight as delayed to 16:00.
